addr: UG - 09 C, Upper Ground Floor, Orion Mall, Brigade Gateway 26 / 1 Dr Rajkumar Road, Malleswaram, West, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560055, India

rev.t: Visited during the Cricket T20 Worldcup 2026 and it was a nice place to hang out. Small but outdoor seating and view of the water fall of the Orion mall. Took beer, veg nachas as they didn't have chicken nachos, peri peri chicken wings, crispy chicken and pepper pork. Service was good. Nachos was average. Over all good experience.

Good food and good beer—sometimes those basics are all you need for a great experience! The malai kabab and watermelon labneh salad are absolute must-tries. I also really enjoyed their new brew, Pop Fiction. My only minor complaint was that the second serving, while cold, had lost its crisp fizz and felt a bit flat.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
